doc: blender/README.md + kit/props/obby.py. The obby's voxel cloud set, built with the lobby_cloud recipe (LobbyBuilder._CloudGrid of a VX.Cloud spec: tiers, puffs, rim, carve; one baked SmoothPlastic MeshPart 'Cloud'). cloud_obby_far_<n> (distant cumulus, pivot = the base tier's top centre, flat base), cloud_obby_sea_<n> (the cloud sea under the route, pivot = the top centre of its flat deck, billows rise up to 3 voxels over it), cloud_obby_under_<s|m|l|pad> (the puff a platform's slab sits in: pivot = attachment Seat = the slab's underside centre, a one-voxel rim around the slab footprint that stays below the walking top), obby_storm_cloud (the dark cloud over a Storm step, pivot = the base's bottom centre). Wired by the OBBY lane (Config.Course.Clouds) once the keys have ids.
